post.description: Find US stores near a postal code or city and state, nearest first with the distance in miles. Returns the fixed nearest set Domino's publishes for the query (at most 10 stores) in one complete response; the store lookup has no page, limit, cursor or radius parameter upstream, so this is not paginated and nothing beyond that set is reachable for one query.

service_method.description:
CARRYOUT (default) returns the nearest stores for the postal code or city and state; each store reports availability.delivery. Domino's answers a DELIVERY store search only for a full street address, which this function does not take, so DELIVERY fails with invalid_input (street_address_required) rather than an upstream error.

Provider reference: allowed values ["CARRYOUT", "DELIVERY"]; default "CARRYOUT".
